steps.cap: Sealed pods carry wafers from tool to tool on a track near the ceiling.
The first tool lays a thin film on the wafer.
The next prints a pattern on it with light.
An etch tool cuts the pattern into the film.
The wafer is cleaned, then measured to check the layer came out right.
Then the loop starts again for the next layer. The transistors come first, then the wiring above them.
Making one chip takes 1,000 to 1,500 steps, the Semiconductor Industry Association estimated in 2025.
